summary: Independent read-only review of the complete diff vs main, two rounds. Round 1 on 7fbf579 was FIX-FIRST: the phone menu sheet had no fill (an opacity modifier on a token-mapped colour emits no CSS) and calendar chips used a hairline colour as text; plus hover, selected-state and reduced-effects findings. Round 2 on this commit: both highs and M1, M2 (mostly), M5 resolved; the glass audit now rejects any opacity modifier on token colours and was judged stricter with nothing loosened; no test or audit weakened; logic-file edits presentation only. Remaining: two medium contrast findings scheduled for removal by later milestones of this PR (quality badge on posters, hero pick pill over artwork), and lows (no Settings control for reduced effects yet, unused density accessors and two button classes, residual violet in settings/player/onboarding rules, two stale comments, larger font file). Reviewer ran nothing; Go suite, 1582 unit tests and the full audit were run green separately on this commit.
